title: Xingke Unified API Protocol for Two-Wheeler Charging Devices

connectorId.description: Logical charging channel number, starting at 1. Current 16-channel devices use 1-16. Required for multichannel devices; optional for a single channel.

transactionId.description: Partner-generated charging correlation ID. This device profile requires a 20-digit string, preserving leading zeros.

startSource.description: Remote means remote start; Card means card-initiated start.

chargingMode.description: AutoStop stops when fully charged; Timed uses a specified duration.

duration.description: Required for Timed, in seconds: 60-59880, a multiple of 60. Forbidden for AutoStop.

idTag.description: 10-digit decimal card-number string, preserving leading zeros.

status.description: Accepted means a valid card; Invalid means an invalid card.

cardType.description: Balance means a balance-based card; Period means an expiry-date card. Required only when Accepted.

balance.description: Balance in CNY cents (fen), API range 0-2147483647. Required only for Accepted with Balance. Any lower firmware limit is checked against confirmed capabilities.

expiryDate.description: Card expiry date, YYYY-MM-DD, interpreted in Asia/Shanghai. Required only for Accepted with Period.

floatChargingDuration.description: Float-charge duration, seconds: 1800-10800, in whole minutes.

maxChargingDuration.description: Maximum charging duration, seconds: 60-48000, in whole minutes. The 60-second minimum is an API constraint.

chargingStatusInterval.description: Charging status and metering reporting interval, seconds: 300-3600.

powerLimit.description: Overload power threshold, watts. Reference write range: 500-1000; confirmed firmware capabilities are also required.

offlineStopDuration.description: Delay before power-off when offline, seconds: 300-5400, in whole minutes. Confirmed firmware capabilities are also required.

type.description: Only Soft is supported, meaning a software restart.

location.description: Device-accessible firmware download URL. HTTP or HTTPS support depends on firmware capabilities. Semicolons, carriage returns and line feeds are forbidden.

status.description: Succeeded: confirmed device success. Failed: explicit failure. Unknown: unconfirmed. Sent: successful send only, with no device acknowledgement.

message.description: Human-readable explanation; not used for program logic.
